hints.title: Combinations With Repetition
hints.text: Choosing n vowels with repetition from five vowels is equivalent to the stars and bars problem.

hints.title: Combinatorial Formula
hints.text: The total number of sorted vowel strings of length n is comb(n + 4, 4).

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all 5^n strings and testing sorted property causes exponential blowup.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Closed-form combination formula computes the result in constant time and space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate recognizes stars and bars formulation comb(n + 5 - 1, 5 - 1).

solutions.approach: Combinatorial closed form stars and bars
